results.title: 10 Open World Games Where You Conquer The Map
results.content: # 10 Open World Games Where You Conquer The Map. Jay (He/They) is a fiction writer and high school teacher. The main draw of any open-world game is that it **offers adventure and exploration,** allowing players to go anywhere they want. Here are some games that let you explore a massive world while you wrest control of areas from your enemies. : PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One. As a story centered around a Rebellion fighting against an oppressive regime, the *Just Cause* series features liberation missions where players can take over key areas to weaken the enemy's control over a region. *Dying Light 2* features Bandit Camps and Windmills as points of interest that serve as major areas for the player to take over and establish safe zones for fellow survivors. Much like its predecessor, *Tom Clancy's The Division 2* features a quarantined section of a major city in a dystopian America--this time Washington D.C.--**split into different zones that players must explore and conquer from different factions.**. With a wide, diverse selection of classes and abilities, players can liberate Control Zones and find Settlements to find some semblance of peace in the broken city of D.C. There are also Dark Zones--**areas that are too dangerous for players to conquer,** as they hold hidden dangers like powerful enemies and Rogue Agents--players who thrive in the chaos of PvP. The open-world portion of *Odyssey* involves the **typical outpost-clearing missions where you take out enemy troops and the commander**, but you can also weaken the region by assassinating the leader and sabotaging the area. Besides having an innovative nemesis mechanic and intense combat, *Shadow of Mordor* is an open-world game that populates Mordor's bleak land with many orc camps and patrols. Yes*, Death Stranding*looks like a single-player game, but it has **multiplayer elements that allow you to** **connect to a server with other players.**. Not only will liberating these zones provide fast travel points on the map, but some settlements **will provide shops and resources** for you to further your war against the Mongols. ##### 10 Open World Games With Multiple Maps.
